intro.sr: Za proizvode čija je cena previše promenljiva da bi se automatski prikazala, klijent ne može da kupi direktno - šalje upit, a administrator ručno kreira porudžbinu sa dogovorenom cenom.
intro.en: For products whose price is too volatile to show automatically, the customer can't buy directly - they send an inquiry, and the admin manually creates the order with the agreed price.

otvaranje-proizvoda-na-upit.sr: Klijent otvara proizvod i vidi „Cena na upit” umesto cene - nema dugmeta za dodavanje u korpu.
otvaranje-proizvoda-na-upit.en: The customer opens the product and sees "Price on request" instead of a price - there's no add-to-cart button.

prelazak-na-kontakt-formu.sr: Klikom na „Kontaktirajte nas za cenu”, klijent stiže na kontakt formu, već predpopunjenu imenom proizvoda.
prelazak-na-kontakt-formu.en: Clicking "Contact us for a price" takes the customer to the contact form, already pre-filled with the product name.

popunjavanje-upita.sr: Klijent unosi svoje podatke i poruku.
popunjavanje-upita.en: The customer enters their details and a message.

slanje-upita.sr: Klijent šalje upit - ovim se ne pravi nikakva porudžbina, samo poruka za admina.
slanje-upita.en: The customer sends the inquiry - this doesn't create any order yet, just a message for the admin.

admin-prijava.sr: Administrator se prijavljuje da bi obradio upit.
admin-prijava.en: The admin logs in to handle the inquiry.

admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na dropdown sa svojim imenom.
admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.en: The admin clicks the dropdown showing their name.

admin-porudzbine-bira-stavku.en: The admin picks "Orders" from the menu.

admin-porudzbine-klik-na-dodaj.sr: Administrator klikne „Nova porudžbina (ručno)” - forma van normalnog checkout-a, baš za ovakve slučajeve.
admin-porudzbine-klik-na-dodaj.en: The admin clicks "New order (manual)" - a form outside the normal checkout, made for exactly this case.

admin-bira-proizvod.sr: Administrator bira proizvod i njegovu varijantu - lista jasno pokazuje da je cena „na upit”.
admin-bira-proizvod.en: The admin selects the product and its variant - the list clearly shows the price is "on request".

admin-unosi-kontakt-i-cenu.sr: Administrator unosi podatke klijenta i, ključno, ručno unetu cenu - bez ovoga porudžbina ne bi mogla da se napravi za ovaj proizvod.
admin-unosi-kontakt-i-cenu.en: The admin enters the customer's details and, critically, a hand-entered price - without this, an order for this product couldn't be created at all.

admin-kreira-porudzbinu.sr: Administrator kreira porudžbinu - ovo odmah pravi pravu porudžbinu, bez ikakvog dodatnog koraka potvrde od strane klijenta.
admin-kreira-porudzbinu.en: The admin creates the order - this immediately creates a real order, with no further confirmation step from the customer.
